shape: an everyday thing everyone thinks they already understand, seen new through one small moment most people have lived

slides.text: i left [[the clean laundry]] on the bedroom chair, because clean was close enough for tonight.

caption:
some days you put everything in drawers, and some days you just turn the lamp off.
my best friend taught me that an unfolded pile never hurt anybody.
send this to the person who has lived out of a clean laundry basket all week.

#selflovequotes #bekindtoyourself #rest
alt: a tiny truth about leaving clean clothes on the bedroom chair at the end of a long day
hook_options: i left [[the clean laundry]] on the bedroom chair, because clean was close enough for tonight.
